title: Cashew Nut Brittle
description: Caramelised sugar with salted butter and raw cashew nuts, set into a brittle slab and smashed into shards. Rich, crunchy and satisfying.
steps: Prepare a chopping board covered with greaseproof paper.
Put the sugar in a pan over a low heat and caramelise without stirring, tilting the pan to even the heat (about 6 minutes, or 150°C on a sugar thermometer).
Add the butter — it will sizzle. Keep on low heat until the foaming stops.
Add the cashews and stir until fully coated in caramel. Cook for another 3–4 minutes.
Tip on to the prepared surface, spread out the nuts evenly with a spatula.
Leave to set for 1–2 hours, then smash into pieces with a rolling pin.
notes: Serves 6–8. Keeps crunchy for 4 days in a sealed tin. Sprinkle with coarse sea salt when finished.
